parties.respondent: The State of Uttar Pradesh and Others

summary: The appellant, Shraddha Gupta, challenged the refusal of the Allahabad High Court to quash criminal proceedings against her under Sections 2/3 of the Uttar Pradesh Gangsters and Anti-Social Activities (Prevention) Act, 1986. She was implicated in further investigation and charged via supplementary charge sheet in connection with the murder of Sadhna Sharma, which allegedly involved gang-related activity. The appellant argued she was falsely implicated, not a gangster or gang member, and that a single incident cannot justify invoking the preventive provisions of the Gangsters Act. The State contended that due procedure was followed, including preparation and approval of a gang chart, and that co-accused were similarly charged. Key legal issue: whether the appellant can be prosecuted under the Gangsters Act based on a single incident and subsequent inclusion in the case.
legal_provisions_cited: Section 2/3, Uttar Pradesh Gangsters and Anti-Social Activities (Prevention) Act, 1986
Piyush Kantilal Mehta v. Commissioner of Police, Ahmedabad City, 1989 Supp (1) SCC 322
Karansinh Chetansinh Vaghela v. State of Gujarat, 2021 SCConLine Gujarat 1260
final_judgment: The appeal was heard by the Supreme Court, but the final disposition (allowance or dismissal) is not specified in the provided text.
